mechanism: Establish one tiny protagonist crossing a single oversized terrain, then make that same substrate change physical role in a causal ladder: reliable footing becomes resistance, resistance becomes an improvised carrier, and the carrier becomes an elastic transition. Only after the protagonist has attempted those states, introduce one full-scale tool exactly once as a final bridge. End with the protagonist back in a stable self-possessed pose so scale assistance resolves the route without erasing agency.

invariants.rule: Prove the protagonist-to-terrain scale relation in the opening before the first obstacle.
invariants.purpose: Turns scale into usable story geography rather than a delayed reveal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without early scale proof, later material deformation reads as arbitrary VFX.

invariants.rule: Make one continuous substrate perform at least three visibly different physical roles in causal order.
invariants.purpose: Lets the environment generate the action ladder without introducing unrelated threats.
invariants.ablation_failure: If every beat uses a new prop, the sequence becomes a montage instead of one evolving material problem.

invariants.rule: Let each attempted solution expose the next material state rather than resetting the route.
invariants.purpose: Preserves causal momentum and makes escalation legible.
invariants.ablation_failure: Independent gags remove the sense that the traveler is learning and adapting.

invariants.rule: Use one late external-scale tool exactly once as a bridge, not as the opening scale reveal.
invariants.purpose: Provides a stronger second scale proof and a decisive transition after self-propelled effort.
invariants.ablation_failure: An early or repeated giant tool steals agency and collapses the material traversal into handling.

invariants.rule: End on a stable pose that visibly restores agency after the external bridge.
invariants.purpose: Prevents assistance from becoming defeat and gives the action chain a performance payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending in midair or on the tool leaves the causal result unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original, stable subject or group with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues supporting state changes.

anti_copy_exclusions: tiny chibi man on giant pepperoni pizza

instantiations.concept: A tiny greenhouse courier crosses one enormous waxy leaf: the surface shifts from firm ridge to slick dew sheet to elastic vein sling, then one full-size glass pipette enters once as a bridge before the courier lands beside a seed marker.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Tiny greenhouse courier, giant waxy leaf, dew-to-vein material ladder, single late pipette bridge, confident seed-marker landing.

instantiations.concept: A miniature archive scout traverses one giant folded linen map: crisp fold, snagging loose thread and springing fabric pocket form the ladder; one brass compass leg enters once as the final bridge before a wax-seal pose.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Mini archive scout, giant linen map, fold-thread-pocket material ladder, single brass compass bridge, wax-seal finish.

instantiations.concept: A micro survey rover crosses one giant translucent soap film: stable skin, sticky foam rim and elastic membrane recoil form the route; one full-size squeegee edge enters once as a ramp before a dry-platform finish.
